title: Grand Prix Promos: card flavor text

paragraphs.text: During the collision of the shards, entire ways of life disappeared without a trace.
"I've been all over this world. I even remember some of those places."
Its scales contain the essence of thousands of lotus blooms.
"The emergence of the Eldrazi isn't necessarily a bad thing, as long as you've already lived a fulfilling and complete life without regrets." —Javad Nasrin, Ondu relic hunter
"Avacyn emerged from the broken Helvault, but her freedom came at a price—him." —Thalia, Knight-Cathar
The Soul of the World has returned.
Some worlds possess a hidden core where life's essence constantly surges.
